column1: # gen1: constant folds MWCC made and the host would not (decided 2026-11-07: by retail evidence, never by host constness).
# MWCC folds a float expression of constants at compile time, rounding to nearest. Where the generated code instead
# computes it at run time in ps2f (PS2 chop), because the constants pass through an inline helper's ps2f parameters,
# decomp2host replaces the exact source text below with the expression spelled out in the helper's own operation order,
# using retail's folded constant. A plain literal pair (`1.0f / 255.0f`) needs no entry: C++ folds it to nearest too.
# Each entry applies exactly once in the unit of its function, or the generation fails.
# Found by tools/decomp2host/fold_scan.py (retail constants = nearest(a op b) of the unit's literals, != chop).
